issue.title: Finish plan-sidecar prompt archive migration for SDD validation
issue.description: Reproduction: in a clean numbered sase workspace, run 'sase repo open plans' and then 'sase validate' (or 'just check'). Plan-link validation fails with 5,764 errors and 519 warnings. The dominant errors are prompt-in-plans-store for Markdown still under month/prompts directories and link-missing-target for plan frontmatter that still points at relative prompts/<name>.md after prompts moved to the canonical agents-sidecar archive. Scope: complete or correct the durable sidecar/link migration so a clean current plans checkout resolves canonical archived prompts and passes plan-link validation without restoring duplicate prompt Markdown to the plans store.
